changes.text: Park unused cash in GBP money market (CSH2.L)
changes.rationale: The agent has been 100% idle cash earning nothing; money market earns ~Bank Rate while it waits for signals

changes.text: Enter on 2-day RSI below 15 instead of 10
changes.rationale: Zero signals so far; a slightly looser trigger still captures short-term oversold dips but trades often enough to matter

changes.text: Stop out any position 8% below cost
changes.rationale: Mean reversion fails when a dip becomes a trend change; cap the loss on those
